articles.title: Fit pattern/base swatch into box
articles.summary: Instead of tiling across the sheet, fit one copy of the pattern / base texture into the drawn box. It is an on/off switch.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > APPLY AREA.
when: One big logo-like pattern placed in one area.
how: Click to switch it on or off.

controls.label: Fit pattern/base swatch into box
controls.effect: Instead of tiling across the sheet, fit one copy of the pattern / base texture...

pitfalls: Only base + pattern are fitted, not spec overlays.
aliases: fit pattern base swatch into box

combos.why: Works together with the Draw box control.

articles.title: Pattern 1 picker (name + dropdown arrow)
articles.summary: Choose the pattern from the catalogue; "None" (x) removes it. It is a colour picker.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > PATTERN. Range any PATTERN_REGISTRY id or 'none', starts at none.
how: Click the colour swatch and pick a colour.

controls.label: Pattern 1 picker (name + dropdown arrow)
controls.effect: Choose the pattern from the catalogue; "None" (x) removes it

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: Paints a repeating design (camo, carbon, scales, hex, flames ...) on the zone. Camo / animal-skin patterns bring their own light/dark tones that sit on the zone colour. Applies to: Patterns are paint art drawn over the base colour. Needs a base.

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: Behind the scenes it sets the zone pattern. It runs over any PATTERN_REGISTRY id or 'none' and starts at none. Measured in id.

deep.heading: How it combines with other controls
deep.body: MEASURED: in Overlay paint mode a pattern paints its own colours (snake_skin_3 = brown) and the base colour does not show; use Blend mode (keeps paint colour) or hue shift to recolour. Pattern colours follow the base colour: in 'overlay' paint mode the pattern replaces colour, in 'blend' mode it keeps the paint colour and only modulates it (so the base colour decides the camo hue). Extra patterns stack (pattern_stack, max 4 more).

protips: Typical values: Rattlesnake = pattern 'snake_skin_3' (hourglass viper saddles); snake_skin / snake_skin_2 are other scale styles; camo = 'multicam' / 'camo'. Pink pattern: Blend mode or hue shift.

faq.q: What does Pattern 1 picker (name + dropdown arrow) do?
faq.a: Choose the pattern from the catalogue; "None" (x) removes it.

faq.q: When should I use Pattern 1 picker (name + dropdown arrow)?
faq.a: Add or remove a pattern.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of Pattern 1 picker (name + dropdown arrow)?
faq.a: Range any PATTERN_REGISTRY id or 'none'. It starts at none.

articles.title: Add Layer (pattern)
articles.summary: Adds a second / third pattern layer to the zone. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > PATTERN. Range up to 4 extra layers; opacity 0-100, scale 10-400%, rotation 0-359, blend normal|multiply|screen|overlay, starts at empty.

controls.label: Add Layer (pattern)
controls.range: up to 4 extra layers; opacity 0-100, scale 10-400%, rotation 0-359, blend normal|multiply|screen|overlay
controls.effect: Adds a second / third pattern layer to the zone

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: A second, third ... pattern on top of the first, each with its own size, angle and blend. Applies to: Patterns.

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: It runs over up to 4 extra layers; opacity 0-100, scale 10-400%, rotation 0-359, blend normal|multiply|screen|overlay and starts at empty. Measured in layers.

deep.heading: How it combines with other controls
deep.body: Each layer has its own scale/rotation/opacity independent of pattern 1.

faq.q: What does + Add Layer (pattern) do?
faq.a: Adds a second / third pattern layer to the zone.

faq.q: When should I use + Add Layer (pattern)?
faq.a: Combine patterns.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of + Add Layer (pattern)?
faq.a: Range up to 4 extra layers; opacity 0-100, scale 10-400%, rotation 0-359, blend normal|multiply|screen|overlay. It starts at empty.

combos.why: Works together with the Pattern 1 picker (name + dropdown arrow) control.

articles.title: Paint mode (Overlay / Blend)
articles.summary: Overlay = the pattern paints its own colours over the paint; Blend = it keeps the underlying paint colour. It is a drop-down menu.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > PATTERN. Range overlay | blend, starts at overlay.
when: The pattern covers the colour you chose (use Blend), or will not take your colour.
how: Open the menu and pick a choice.

controls.label: Paint mode (Overlay / Blend)
controls.effect: Overlay = the pattern paints its own colours over the paint; Blend = it keeps...

pitfalls: In Overlay the pattern's own colours win, so the base colour is hidden - use Blend or Hue to recolour.

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: Overlay draws the pattern's own colours over the paint; Blend keeps the paint colour and only modulates light/dark with the pattern. Applies to: All pattern layers of the zone.

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: Behind the scenes it sets the zone pattern paint mode. It runs over overlay | blend and starts at overlay. Measured in mode.

deep.heading: How it combines with other controls
deep.body: In blend mode the base/zone colour (and hue shift) decides the pattern's hue - the right mode for 'camo in MY colour'.

protips: Typical values: Wanted a pattern in a specific colour: set blend mode + colour the base. Wanted the pattern's own palette: overlay.

faq.q: What does Paint mode (Overlay / Blend) do?
faq.a: Overlay = the pattern paints its own colours over the paint; Blend = it keeps the underlying paint colour.

faq.q: When should I use Paint mode (Overlay / Blend)?
faq.a: The pattern covers the colour you chose (use Blend), or will not take your colour.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of Paint mode (Overlay / Blend)?
faq.a: Range overlay | blend. It starts at overlay.

faq.q: Why does Paint mode (Overlay / Blend) not seem to do what I expect?
faq.a: In Overlay the pattern's own colours win, so the base colour is hidden - use Blend or Hue to recolour.

combos.why: Works together with the Hue / Saturation (pattern) control.
Works together with the Pattern 1 picker (name + dropdown arrow) control.

articles.title: Opacity (pattern)
articles.summary: How visible the pattern is, 0-100%. It is a slider.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > PATTERN. Range 0-100 step 5, starts at 100.
how: Drag the slider, or click it and use the arrow keys.

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: How visible the pattern is: 0 invisible, 100 full. Lower = the base colour shows through the pattern. Applies to: Patterns.

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: Behind the scenes it sets the zone pattern opacity. It runs over 0-100 step 5 and starts at 100. Measured in %.

deep.heading: How it combines with other controls
deep.body: Different from Strength (patternSpecMult): opacity fades the pattern, strength scales its paint/spec effect.

protips: Typical values: 'subtle / faint' = 30-50; 'full' = 100; a pattern that fights the base colour -> 50-70.

faq.q: What does Opacity (pattern) do?
faq.a: How visible the pattern is, 0-100%.

faq.q: When should I use Opacity (pattern)?
faq.a: Pattern too loud.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of Opacity (pattern)?
faq.a: Range 0-100 step 5. It starts at 100.

combos.why: Works together with the Strength (pattern) control.

articles.title: Strength (pattern)
articles.summary: Pattern paint strength in 5% steps; spec amount is separate. It is a slider.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > PATTERN. Range 0-100%, starts at 100%.
how: Drag the slider, or click it and use the arrow keys.

controls.label: Strength (pattern)
controls.effect: Pattern paint strength in 5% steps; spec amount is separate

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: Pattern effect in paint and spec: 0 removes the effect. Applies to: Patterns.

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: Behind the scenes it sets the zone pattern spec mult. It runs over 0-100% and starts at 100%. Measured in %.

deep.heading: How it combines with other controls
deep.body: Pairs with Opacity. The help text says spec amount is independent.

protips: Typical values: Leave at 100; use opacity for 'subtle'.

faq.q: What does Strength (pattern) do?
faq.a: Pattern paint strength in 5% steps; spec amount is separate.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of Strength (pattern)?
faq.a: Range 0-100%. It starts at 100%.

combos.why: Works together with the Opacity (pattern) control.

articles.title: Hue / Saturation (pattern)
articles.summary: Recolours only the pattern artwork (hue -180..180, saturation -100..100). It is a slider.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > PATTERN. Overlay mode uses this colour. Range hue -180..180, sat -100..100, starts at 0.
when: Pattern has the wrong colour but the base colour is right.
how: Drag the slider, or click it and use the arrow keys.

controls.label: Hue / Saturation (pattern)
controls.effect: Recolours only the pattern artwork (hue -180..180, saturation -100..100)

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: Would recolour the pattern art alone. Applies to: Pattern layer colours.

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: Behind the scenes it sets the zone pattern hue shift and pattern saturation. It runs over hue -180..180, sat -100..100 and starts at 0. Measured in degrees / points.

protips: Typical values: To recolour a pattern use the zone hue shift or blend mode + base colour instead.

faq.q: What does Hue / Saturation (pattern) do?
faq.a: Recolours only the pattern artwork (hue -180..180, saturation -100..100).

faq.q: When should I use Hue / Saturation (pattern)?
faq.a: Pattern has the wrong colour but the base colour is right.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of Hue / Saturation (pattern)?
faq.a: Range hue -180..180, sat -100..100. It starts at 0.

combos.why: Works together with the Paint mode (Overlay / Blend) control.

articles.title: Spec amount (pattern)
articles.summary: Starts at 0% so your base shine stays; raise to reveal the pattern's own metal / rough / coat. It is a slider.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > PATTERN. Range 0-100%, starts at 100%.
when: Pattern should also change the shine.
how: Drag the slider, or click it and use the arrow keys.

controls.label: Spec amount (pattern)
controls.effect: Starts at 0% so your base shine stays; raise to reveal the pattern's own metal...

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: Pattern effect in paint and spec: 0 removes the effect. Applies to: Patterns.

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: Behind the scenes it sets the zone pattern spec mult. It runs over 0-100% and starts at 100%. Measured in %.

deep.heading: How it combines with other controls
deep.body: Pairs with Opacity. The help text says spec amount is independent.

protips: Typical values: Leave at 100; use opacity for 'subtle'.

faq.q: What does Spec amount (pattern) do?
faq.a: Starts at 0% so your base shine stays; raise to reveal the pattern's own metal / rough / coat.

faq.q: When should I use Spec amount (pattern)?
faq.a: Pattern should also change the shine.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of Spec amount (pattern)?
faq.a: Range 0-100%. It starts at 100%.

faq.q: Why does Spec amount (pattern) not seem to do what I expect?
faq.a: Spec starts at 0 on purpose.

articles.title: Scale (pattern)
articles.summary: Size of the pattern: smaller = more repeats, larger = zoomed in (0.1x to 4x). It is a slider.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > PATTERN. Range 0.10x-4.0x (slider 10-400, step 5), starts at 1.0.
when: "Crush the pattern finer", or make it bigger.
how: Drag the slider, or click it and use the arrow keys.

controls.label: Scale (pattern)
controls.effect: Size of the pattern: smaller = more repeats, larger = zoomed in (0.1x to 4x)

pitfalls: On a whole-car canvas a normal-size pattern looks huge: go below 1.0x for fine detail.

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: Smaller number = the pattern repeats more times = a FINER weave / smaller scales / tighter camo. 0.5 = twice as fine. Owner's 'crushed to 50%' means scale 0.5. (Viewed: 0.5 gives a dense fine scale mesh.). Applies to: Patterns (and the monolithic's own texture when a monolithic is the zone finish).

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: It runs over 0.10x-4.0x (slider 10-400, step 5) and starts at 1.0. Measured in x.

deep.heading: How it combines with other controls
deep.body: Separate from Base Scale (base texture) and spec-pattern scale. The car is a 2048 sheet: scale 1 can read big on the car, finer is usually right for scales / weave.

protips: Typical values: 'finer / tighter / small scales / crushed to N%' -> scale = N/100; 'big / bold' -> 1.6-2.2.

faq.q: What does Scale (pattern) do?
faq.a: Size of the pattern: smaller = more repeats, larger = zoomed in (0.1x to 4x).

faq.q: When should I use Scale (pattern)?
faq.a: "Crush the pattern finer", or make it bigger.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of Scale (pattern)?
faq.a: Range 0.10x-4.0x (slider 10-400, step 5). It starts at 1.0.

faq.q: Why does Scale (pattern) not seem to do what I expect?
faq.a: On a whole-car canvas a normal-size pattern looks huge: go below 1.0x for fine detail.

combos.why: Works together with the Rotate (pattern) control.
Works together with the Base Scale control.

articles.title: Rotate (pattern)

articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > PATTERN. Range 0-359, starts at 0.
when: Stripes / weave at the wrong angle.
how: Drag the slider, or click it and use the arrow keys.

controls.label: Rotate (pattern)
controls.effect: Rotates the pattern 0-359 degrees (also a number box)

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: Turns the pattern (stripes / weave direction). Applies to: Patterns.

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: Behind the scenes it sets the zone rotation. It runs over 0-359 and starts at 0. Measured in degrees.

faq.q: What does Rotate (pattern) do?
faq.a: Rotates the pattern 0-359 degrees (also a number box).

faq.q: When should I use Rotate (pattern)?
faq.a: Stripes / weave at the wrong angle.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of Rotate (pattern)?
faq.a: Range 0-359. It starts at 0.

combos.why: Works together with the Scale (pattern) control.

articles.title: Pattern placement
articles.summary: Choose how the pattern is placed: tiled over the sheet, fitted to the zone, or dragged by hand on the template. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > PATTERN. Range offsets 0-100 (step 5), starts at 50 / normal.
when: Place a pattern on one spot.

controls.label: Pattern placement
controls.effect: Choose how the pattern is placed: tiled over the sheet, fitted to the zone, or...

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: Slides, mirrors or fits the pattern inside the zone (fit = pattern stretched into the zone's area). Applies to: Patterns.

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: It runs over offsets 0-100 (step 5) and starts at 50 / normal. Measured in %.

deep.heading: How it combines with other controls
deep.body: 'fit' changes how scale reads (a pattern fitted to a small panel).

protips: Typical values: Only for placing a motif on a specific panel; whole-car fields leave it centred.

faq.q: What does Pattern placement do?
faq.a: Choose how the pattern is placed: tiled over the sheet, fitted to the zone, or dragged by hand on the template.

faq.q: When should I use Pattern placement?
faq.a: Place a pattern on one spot.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of Pattern placement?
faq.a: Range offsets 0-100 (step 5). It starts at 50 / normal.
